project: CRM M02 revocation notices and cross-module correction

ci_controls.description: Failed-evidence remediation and review stay append-only, serialized and idempotent
Cold-start reconstruction checks history completeness and 3-module HOLD
Snapshot digest and rollback checks only within test PostgreSQL
Ed25519 signature, rotation, revocation and trusted-attester admission are fixture-tested
Quarantine events, dual-domain review, evidence linkage and tenant isolation are tested
Security HOLD and forbidden release remain enforced throughout fixture acceptance
Cross-stage integration audit runs on this Draft PR

production_gaps.requirement: Production IAM, scoped service identities and independent privileged access review
Non-bypassable production cryptographic verification, HSM/KMS and key lifecycle attestation
Independent WORM external audit anchor, trusted timestamps and externally verified backups
Real-time attester compromise monitoring, response drills and documented recovery controls
Real orders, student-level attribution and immutable original sales history reconciliation
Funds, refunds and compensating entries independently reconciled and accepted
Delivery, class and learner record correction independently reconciled and accepted
Multi-service disaster recovery, message delivery, failover and rollback game day
Evidence provenance, privacy, retention and immutable independent forensic review
Production deployment controls, isolation release design and independent UAT approval

explicit_non_evidence: Green CI is not proof of production UAT or release authorization
Two PostgreSQL databases in the same CI cluster are not independent external WORM
False-positive candidate, valid chain and two reviews do not lift security quarantine
This artifact contains no valid production signoff or attestation
